entities.name: the pale lumenmoth
entities.description: A pale moth with translucent wings drifts near whatever light the room has not explained.
observe: Its wings catch the room's light without quite reflecting it.
It keeps a respectful distance, circling once before settling somewhere you are not looking directly at.
For a moment its shadow arrives before the moth does.

accepted: The pale lumenmoth keeps its place as you come nearer.
It shifts once in the light, but does not retreat.
declined: The pale lumenmoth drifts farther toward the edge of the room.
It rises out of easy reach and keeps the distance.
deferred: The moth is too settled into its own stillness to answer your approach just now.

accepted: The lumenmoth permits the shared quiet.
It continues its small orbit while you remain nearby.
declined: The moth chooses another pocket of the room.

accepted: The lumenmoth circles the offered object once, attending without taking it.
declined: The moth gives the offered object no special attention.

accepted: The moth's orbit settles closer, as though leaving the invitation open.
declined: The lumenmoth keeps its own route.
The lumenmoth lifts away before contact. The answer is clear.

entities.name: the little processional
entities.description: A palm-sized brass creature walks on four narrow feet, pausing at thresholds as though listening for permission.
observe: It taps one brass foot against the floor and waits for the room to answer.
No visible mechanism explains how the little construct chooses a direction.
It stops at every threshold. It has never mistaken an opening for permission.

accepted: The little processional taps one foot and allows you into its small radius.
It stays by the fire and makes no objection to your approach.
declined: The processional angles its brass body away and keeps a little room between you.

accepted: The processional appears entirely content to share the fire in silence.
It remains posted near the Hearth. Apparently this counts as company.
The processional leans toward the offered object and studies it with patient little taps.
declined: The processional regards the object, then returns its attention to the fire.

accepted: The processional turns toward the nearest lawful path. It will consider following when you move.
declined: The processional remains firmly committed to its present post.

accepted: The brass shell is cool and finely textured beneath your hand. The processional permits the contact.
declined: The processional steps one careful pace aside.
deferred: The processional is resting. It does not open that possibility just now.

entities.name: the loose threadling
entities.description: Something like a living knot of pale thread rests in the seams between objects, loosening and gathering itself by turns.
observe: It has no obvious face, but one loop of thread turns toward the oldest object in the room.
The knot rearranges itself without ever becoming untied.
A strand reaches toward a nearby object, stops short of touching it, and curls back into the whole.

accepted: The threadling loosens one pale loop toward you and remains.
It gathers itself but does not withdraw from your approach.
declined: The threadling draws its loose strands closer to itself.

accepted: The threadling resumes its quiet rearranging while you share the room.
declined: The knot settles into a seam farther away.

accepted: A strand extends toward the offered object, stopping just short of contact. Its attention is unmistakable.
declined: The threadling curls inward; the object does not call to it this time.

accepted: Several loops orient toward the path beside you. The invitation remains open until you move.
declined: The threadling settles more deeply into the room it has chosen.

accepted: The outermost strand rests briefly against your fingers before curling back into the whole.
declined: The threadling tightens away from your hand without leaving the room.
deferred: The threadling has not yet made room for that kind of contact.
